Use bootstrap multiselect plugin to create your select input which you want to turn into a multiselect. Remember to set the multiple attribute as to get a real multiselect,
but do not worry, the plugin can also be used as usual select without the mutiple attribute being present.

First, the jQuery library needs to be included. Then Twitter Bootstrap - both the Javascript library and the CSS stylesheet - needs to be included.

How to use

If you want to use this style, please see the following instruction:

  • Please create a proper folder (the folder name is a site name which you are working on) inside this folder "styles/vendors-extensions" and copy only necessary CSS codes for forms from this file "styles/vendors/bootstrap.scss".

    For example: styles/vendors-extensions/site-totalbetsforecast/bootstrap-ex.css

  • Add these more file "styles/vendors/bootstrap-multiselect.css", "styles/components/bootstrap-multiselect.css"

For example:

  • styles/vendors-extensions/site-totalbetsforecast/bootstrap-ex.css
  • styles/vendors/bootstrap-multiselect.css
  • styles/components/bootstrap-multiselect.css
  • --- For javascript ---
  • js/libs/jquery/jquery-1.11.3.js
  • js/libs/bootstrap/button.js
  • js/libs/bootstrap/dropdown.js
  • js/components/multiselect/bootstrap-multiselect.js

Select2 gives you a customizable select box with support for searching, tagging, remote data sets, infinite scrolling, and many other highly used options.

Select2 will register itself as a jQuery function if you use any of the distribution builds, so you can call .select2() on any jQuery element where you would like to initialize Select2.

How to use

If you want to use this style, please see the following instruction:

  • Use this file "styles/vendors/select2.css"
  • Add more file "styles/components/select2.css"

For example:

  • styles/vendors/select2.css
  • styles/components/select2.css
  • --- For javascript ---
  • js/libs/jquery/jquery-1.11.3.js
  • js/components/select2/select2.js

Tablesorter is a jQuery plugin for turning a standard HTML table with THEAD and TBODY tags into a sortable table without page refreshes. tablesorter can successfully parse and sort many types of data including linked data in a cell. It has many useful features including:

  • Multi-column sorting
  • Parsers for sorting text, URIs, integers, currency, floats, IP addresses, dates (ISO, long and short formats), time. Add your own easily
  • Support secondary "hidden" sorting (e.g., maintain alphabetical sort when sorting on other criteria)
  • Extensibility via widget system
  • Cross-browser: IE 6.0+, FF 2+, Safari 2.0+, Opera 9.0+
  • Small code size

How to use

If you want to use this style, please see this file "styles/components/tablesorter.css"

For example:

  • styles/components/tablesorter.css

  • js/libs/jquery/jquery-1.11.3.js

Use bootstrap multiselect plugin to create your select input which you want to turn into a multiselect. Remember to set the multiple attribute as to get a real multiselect,
but do not worry, the plugin can also be used as usual select without the mutiple attribute being present.

First, the jQuery library needs to be included. Then Twitter Bootstrap - both the Javascript library and the CSS stylesheet - needs to be included.

How to use

If you want to use this style, please see the following instruction:

  • Please create a proper folder (the folder name is a site name which you are working on) inside this folder "styles/vendors-extensions" and copy only necessary CSS codes for forms from this file "styles/vendors/bootstrap.scss".

    For example: styles/vendors-extensions/site-totalbetsforecast/bootstrap-ex.css

  • Add these more file "styles/vendors/bootstrap-multiselect.css", "styles/components/bootstrap-multiselect.css"

For example:

  • styles/vendors-extensions/site-totalbetsforecast/bootstrap-ex.css
  • styles/vendors/bootstrap-multiselect.css
  • styles/components/bootstrap-multiselect.css
  • --- For javascript ---
  • js/libs/jquery/jquery-1.11.3.js
  • js/libs/bootstrap/button.js
  • js/libs/bootstrap/dropdown.js
  • js/components/multiselect/bootstrap-multiselect.js

Select2 gives you a customizable select box with support for searching, tagging, remote data sets, infinite scrolling, and many other highly used options.

Select2 will register itself as a jQuery function if you use any of the distribution builds, so you can call .select2() on any jQuery element where you would like to initialize Select2.

How to use

If you want to use this style, please see the following instruction:

  • Use this file "styles/vendors/select2.css"
  • Add more file "styles/components/select2.css"

For example:

  • styles/vendors/select2.css
  • styles/components/select2.css
  • --- For javascript ---
  • js/libs/jquery/jquery-1.11.3.js
  • js/components/select2/select2.js

  • Multi-column sorting
  • Parsers for sorting text, URIs, integers, currency, floats, IP addresses, dates (ISO, long and short formats), time. Add your own easily
  • Support secondary "hidden" sorting (e.g., maintain alphabetical sort when sorting on other criteria)
  • Extensibility via widget system
  • Cross-browser: IE 6.0+, FF 2+, Safari 2.0+, Opera 9.0+
  • Small code size

How to use

If you want to use this style, please see this file "styles/components/tablesorter.css"

For example:

  • styles/components/tablesorter.css

  • js/libs/jquery/jquery-1.11.3.js
